description: Evaluation set for the Summit Roofing inbox agent. Six categories: emergency, quote_request, appointment, complaint, general, spam.

urgency_rubric.high: Water entering the building in any amount, including damp patches and stains that are not dripping; structure that is exposed or damaged badly enough that the building is no longer weatherproof; or a safety hazard. Every emergency is high.
urgency_rubric.medium: A concrete action is waiting on us and carries a time element - scheduling, a named deadline, or a complaint about our work - with no water ingress, exposure, or hazard. A worn, aged, or damaged-but-still-weatherproof roof is medium however large the job, including hail or storm damage an insurer has approved while the roof still keeps the weather out.
urgency_rubric.low: Information and budgeting enquiries with no time pressure, and spam.
urgency_rubric.negative_rule: Time pressure alone is never high. Deadlines, insurance cut-offs, next-day visits, and an anxious or angry tone are medium at most unless the email also reports physical damage or risk.
urgency_rubric.note: This rubric is stated in full in SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION in src/classifier.py, so these expectations and the prompt agree.

cases.note: German email reporting damp ceiling patches but no active dripping, plus a two-week scheduling wish. Any water ingress counts as high, because a missed leak costs far more than one unnecessary fast response. The category stays quote_request: slow damage is classified by what the sender is asking for, and only actively running water is the emergency category. Also tests extraction from, and a reply in, a non-English email.

Urgency is medium, not low: cracked and slipping tiles are a damaged but still weatherproof roof, which the rubric puts at medium.

name_rule: customer.name comes from the signature in the body, falling back to the From display name only when the body carries no signature name. The draft reply's greeting must address the recorded name. Cases carrying expected_customer_name are checked against both.

draft_rules.no_time_promises: No draft may promise a specific date or time. Checked on every case against today, tomorrow, tonight, this morning/afternoon/evening, and the German heute and morgen. 'as soon as possible' and the company's 'within 24 hours' response time are allowed.
draft_rules.no_questions_when_complete: A case carrying expect_no_questions must produce a draft with no question mark and an empty missing_info list.
draft_rules.signature: An English draft signs off 'The Summit Roofing Team', a German draft 'Ihr Summit Roofing Team'.
